regime_context: Detector shows a narrow, two-theme leadership structure in China A-shares: Banks (rank 1, crowded, eligible) and Innovative Pharma & CXO (rank 2, crowded, eligible) sit far above a mostly ineligible field. Only 4 of 22 themes are eligible, and backtest verdict flags this market as mean-reverting with the validated trend gate NOT holding here — so the detector is display-only and I treat these leans as low-conviction conditionals, not edge.
emerging_watch: Watching Coal (rank 6, eligible, hurst_tag=mean-revert, breadth 0.30) for a confirmed handoff: if Coal's eligibility persists AND its breadth expands above 0.50 while Banks or Pharma lose eligibility, that would be the observable condition to take it from watch to a named lean.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the top-ranked eligible theme with the highest durability bar (0.73) and broad participation (breadth 0.889), suggesting the leadership is cohesive rather than a single-name spike. The trend gate nominally permits allocation. However, crowding (z=1.78) is elevated, which is a size-down caution, not a reason to expect outperformance per se. With track_record dir_accuracy only 0.377, I hold this lean lightly.
evidence: crowding z=1.78, crowded=true — size-down caution only
theses.dissent: The backtest shows the absolute-trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown on this market's history (mean-reverting tape), so eligibility here carries less weight than in markets where the gate helps; Banks could simply be the last stop before a rotation you cannot predict.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS (Banks ETF) lags the CSI 300 by more than 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO is the only other eligible theme and the rotation challenger with a score nearly level with Banks (margin 0.01). Durability (0.60) is moderate and breadth (0.643) is respectable, indicating a viable second narrative rather than a one-narrative market. Both leaders are crowded, so neither gets a clean endorsement from the detector alone.
theses.dissent: Crowding is elevated in both leaders; if this is a coiled two-theme regime, Pharma could absorb flows from Banks rotation, or both could stall together given the narrow eligible slice (only 4 of 22).

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ (Pharma & CXO ETF) lags the CSI 300 by more than 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute & Optics ranks third but is NOT eligible (trend gate blocks it), with very poor breadth (0.059) — leadership in this theme is concentrated in a tiny slice of names and lacks the participation that marks a durable narrative. Absent eligibility, the detector's only validated edge (drawdown control via the gate) says to stay out.
evidence: crowding z=-0.66 — not crowded, simply weak breadth
theses.dissent: Trend-tagged and uncrowded could mean early accumulation before a breadth expansion; avoiding it risks missing a handoff if breadth suddenly broadens.

falsifier.text: 515000.SS (AI Compute & Optics ETF) gains more than 10% versus CSI 300 over 30 trading days

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
